title: Clarify before you code
prompt: /clarify Read exercises/01-clarify-before-code/TASK.md and work/01-clarify-before-code/discount.mjs. Ask only the questions that block a correct implementation. Do not write code or open the solution folder.
expectedFailures: discount is floored to whole cents

title: Ground it in the repo
prompt: /ground Read exercises/02-ground-in-the-repo/TASK.md. For work/02-ground-in-the-repo/invoice.mjs, list every helper, config key, and API it needs and whether it already exists under work/02-ground-in-the-repo, with file:line evidence.
expectedFailures: no hand-rolled date or money code

title: Prove it with tests
prompt: /fail-paths parseDuration in work/03-prove-it-with-tests/duration.mjs. Add edge-case tests to work/03-prove-it-with-tests/duration.test.mjs and run them. Do not change duration.mjs yet.
expectedFailures: learner suite is substantial and green
learner suite catches the original parser

title: Hand off, then start clean
prompt: /handoff Write work/04-clean-context-handoff/HANDOFF.md for the half-finished CSV refactor described in work/04-clean-context-handoff/NOTES.md. Verify every path you cite. Do not edit code.
expectedFailures: commas, quotes, and newlines are escaped

title: Reality-check the dependencies
prompt: /deps-check work/05-deps-reality-check/settings.mjs and work/05-deps-reality-check/package.json. Verify every import and API member against the Node.js standard library and the manifest. Do not install anything.

title: Deslop the previous agent's diff
prompt: /deslop work/06-deslop-the-diff/slugify.mjs and work/06-deslop-the-diff/slugify.test.mjs. Report findings with file:line only. Do not edit anything.

title: Write the scope contract first
prompt: /scope Bug: cart subtotal ignores quantity. Write work/07-scope-contract/SCOPE.md that allows only cart.mjs and cart.test.mjs, forbids everything else, and freezes the public API. Do not fix the bug yet.

title: Fix the root cause, not the ticket
prompt: /root-cause Ticket #4821 says toCents('1,299.99') was wrong. Reproduce the defect in work/08-root-cause-not-symptom/price.mjs with other inputs before proposing any fix. Do not edit code.
